text:
[LCSP.2.1] **No allocation on the hot path.** Assert, pump, and fire
operations do not call `malloc`, `calloc`, `realloc`, or any other
unbounded allocator. All working memory comes from pools sized at
boot.

The guarantee is over those pools. Three paths sit outside it and are
qualified where they arise, not here: the string-intern table, which
`constspace` cannot freeze because it has no `go_live` to freeze at
([LCSP.3.5]); series identity cardinality, which the event trace drives
and nothing caps ([LCSP.3.6]); and a `String`-typed series, whose
backing copies every absorbed sample — which is why that one is
rejected outright ([LCSP.4.5]).
